sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

Players control their doodle character as it navigates through increasingly challenging obstacles and terrain, with the goal of surviving for as long as possible. The game is divided into levels, each with its own unique obstacles and challenges. Players can earn rewards and power-ups by completing levels, which can be used to unlock new characters, levels, and features.

One of the key mechanics of the game is the doodle character's movement. Players can control the character's movement by dragging their finger left or right, or by pressing the left and right arrow keys on a keyboard. This creates a sense of fluidity and flexibility, allowing players to navigate the game world with ease.

But Doodle Game is more than just a simple navigation game. As players progress through the levels, they'll encounter a range of obstacles, from hazards to enemies, that will test their skills and reaction time.
